verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Xero surfaces cash-flow and profit-trend insights and can generate consolidated financial statements across currencies, plus KPI/dashboard analysis, suggesting core reporting capability exists, but no citation explicitly confirms on-demand generation of a full P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any arbitrary period. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of standard P&L and balance sheet reports, period-selection controls, and independent verification of report accuracy.
